notes: Removed the arbitrary 96px JACK IN actor/operator size.
Each actor and the operator now uses the token's actual on-screen Foundry canvas footprint at JACK IN render time.
JACK IN zoom is exactly cancelled for actors and operator, so they never become bigger or smaller while zooming or panning.
Operator outer frame no longer uses the old 1.62x size multiplier.
All scene anchors remain unchanged, preserving alignment with the full scene, traces, devices, and cameras.
